versions.changelog:
- Initial CLI implementation with entry point and generator script.
- Added package.json for dependency and command management.
- Documentation in SKILL.md updated and standardized (added slug, displayName, version, updated fields).
- First public release.

- Major simplification: all implementation and documentation files except SKILL.md have been removed.
- SKILL.md content rewritten in Chinese, tailored for real-world ToB (business-to-business) project experience, with clearer rules and principles.
- Now focuses on quick, real-scenario output: competitor vs. us comparison, counter-talking points, and actionable sales guidance (no generic or AI-generated responses).
- Usage instructions updated for Chinese command-line workflows.
- Rules and suggested talking points are specified as distilled from actual project experience, with industry-specific strategies.
- Emphasizes: no fabrication of cases, and clear instructions when lacking real competitive data.
